Outline Explanation

Outline explanation using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

outline_explanation(topic)

Example input

{
  "topic": "OAuth with PKCE"
}

Example output

{
  "topic": "OAuth with PKCE",
  "sections": [
    "Mechanism",
    "Worked example",
    "Tradeoffs",
    "Failure modes",
    "Verification"
  ]
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py outline_explanation < examples/outline-explanation.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
